Terms and Conditions

Review our terms and conditions at Above 8000s, outlining our commitments and guidelines for safe and enjoyable trekking, camping, and adventure experiences in Nepal.

Terms of Services

Thank you for visiting above8000.COM. The following terms constitute an agreement between you and Above 8000s .


Outdoor adventures, by their nature, are naturally dangerous sports. Although Above 8000s will take every precaution to ensure your safety and enjoyment, please be aware that accidents can happen. Because much of our outdoor experiences either take place in remote locations, can be disrupted by weather, or there is a chance of injury, there is always the possibility of a disruption of travel plans. These terms and conditions limit the above8000's liability, and define your rights and obligations. Please read them carefully.

Common Terms and Conditions

  • Child below 14 years old and person above 60 years are not allowed.
  • It is mandatory for Person's to present valid photo identification at the time of check-in.
  • The acceptable identification proofs are Passport, Aadhaar Card, Driving License and Voter ID card.
  • All Person are responsible for their own personal belongings.
  • Outside pets are not allowed

SAFETY

above8000.COM takes every precaution to ensure the safety of all participants. However, by undertaking a trip with above8000.com, you are assuming the risk of any injury, including death. To help in minimizing the risks to all involved, you are required to follow all instructions of above8000.com employees and agents. Failure to follow any instructions or recommendations is at your own risk. above8000.com, its employees and agents cannot be held responsible for any injury caused to you, or by you to others, resulting from your failure to follow an instruction(s) or recommendation(s). If your failure to follow any instruction(s) or recommendation(s) causes an increase in risk, or threatens the safety and enjoyment of others on the trip, above8000.com reserves the right to take all reasonable steps to ensure the safety of the other participants, up to and including, immediate termination of your participation in the trip.


INSURANCE

Your reservation of a trip with above8000.COM does not include insurance of any type. All types of insurance are your responsibility. All participants are encouraged to obtain appropriate insurance for your personal belongings, trip interruption, medical and legal expenses, and personal liability as you deem necessary. Although we will take all steps to help you if you get into a difficult situation, above8000.com cannot be held responsible for your failure to secure appropriate insurance.


Above 8000S Rights

The activities you will be engaged in, do often require a reasonable level of physical fitness and agility. above8000.COM reserves the right to reject your booking if your physical condition poses a potential threat to the safety of yourself or other participants. If you have already booked a trip and are subsequently unable to participate because of your physical condition, any change or cancellation to your trip is subject to the provisions otherwise detailed in these Terms and Conditions. Your failure to clear your ability to participate in the trip with above8000.com, as detailed herein, and our subsequent determination that your condition poses a significant safety risk. If you require medications, you should ensure you take enough with you to last the trip. Any medication you take with you, is your responsibility. In saying this, under most circumstances, if you are of an adventurous spirit and in reasonably good health, you should have no problem enjoying above8000.com trips and activities.

NOTE


Liability waiver form - Everyone is required to sign a standard release before any of above8000.COM’s adventure activities, acknowledging awareness that some risks are associated with the trip and/or activities. However, due to the nature of the activities, a condition of your participation is that you will be required to sign this form before the commencement of the activity.

CANCELLATION POLICY

The following time frames govern above8000.com’s obligation to refund any payments made by you for your trip or accommodation reservation:

  • More than 30-days prior to departure - 50% refund.
  • In Between 15-30-days prior to departure - 25% refund.
  • Less than 15-days prior to departure - No Refund

Communication

All the communication will be done through the E-MAIL ID submitted by the user in the registration form or simply VIA CALL.

NOTE


In the event, you fall ill or suffer an accident during the event, all hospital expenses, doctor fees, repatriation expenses, evacuation from road or mountain, any other charges incurred as a direct or indirect result of Your illness / accident are Your Responsibility.
